name: helgatheviking/gp-language-pack-server
description: Generates and serves language pack downloads from GlotPress translations via the WordPress REST API.

prefix-namespaces: sh -c 'test -f bin/strauss.phar || { mkdir -p bin && curl -fL -o bin/strauss.phar https://github.com/BrianHenryIE/strauss/releases/download/0.27.4/strauss.phar; }'

scripts-description.makepot-audit: Generate a .pot file for translation. Dry run.
scripts-description.phpcs: Analyze code against the WordPress coding standards with PHP_CodeSniffer
scripts-description.phpcb: Fix coding standards warnings/errors automatically with PHP Code Beautifier
scripts-description.prefix-namespaces: Prefix namespaces of dependencies with Strauss (downloads bin/strauss.phar if missing)
